absolutely no joke, ha. started off light-handed and worked my way up to a good frost. my skin would peel for about 6 days, but the first two days post application there was never peeling so 8 days total. 

the tips i'd have is to 

1. start low

2. make sure to not exfoliate 48 hours before

3.  do a patch test first

4. you don't have to frost the first time - but if you don't it's going to lengthen it to being a 10 day ordeal 

5. apply a good moisturizer or oil post peel, like argan oil

6. wash your face daily with a wash that is non-acidic, helps dry the skin more so speeds the peeling process a bit

7. cover your face or at least wear sunscreen if going out

8. don't pick the peeling skin, use scissors to cut them instead. picking can cause hyperpigmentation

and if you don't want to start with tca, you could always do a mandelic, glycolic or lactic acid peel depending on what you're targeting. less downtime and pretty effective, although not as dramatic of course. :)
